basic_profile.bio: TechyTrails is a 28-year-old IT consultant based in Austin, Texas. Passionate about all things tech, they have a penchant for gaming and exploring new gadgets. When not working, you can find them cycling through the scenic routes of Austin or strategizing in 'Into the Breach'. They typically browse Reddit during evenings and weekends, fitting it in between work commitments and social hangouts. TechyTrails is single and enjoys the flexibility that comes with it, allowing plenty of time to dive deep into their hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: TechyTrails has a robust background in information technology, having pursued a degree in Computer Science. Their expertise is further honed through a career in IT consultancy, where they troubleshoot and optimize client systems. They are self-taught in gaming peripherals, regularly keeping up with the latest advancements through forums and reviews.
